newsitem.title: USA: GM mulls global reorganization - USA Today.
newsitem.headline: GM mulls global reorganization - USA Today.

text.p: General Motors is considering an international reorganization that could include creating a new executive position to oversee global auto development, USA Today reported Thursday.
GM officials in Europe told the paper that any move could be years away, but said an effort to increase GM's global focus is inevitable.

"It's very clear this is going to happen," Peter Hanenberger, head of GM's international technical development, told the paper. "The vision is clear: Someday we will become one world, one company. This is our vision and what we want to do."
The report said the move could come after GM completes a plan to begin using the same platforms, or chassis, to build similar-size vehicles for different markets around the world.
GM Chief Executive Jack Smith wants the company to cut the number of platforms it uses to seven from 16 during the next decade, the paper said.
